title: Compose shared radix and forward admission across actual pooled preparation
body:
The complete named preparation interval now composes ToikY/[PR #4025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4025)'s shared radix traversal with [PR #4011](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4011)'s forward admission on independently compiled [PR #4010](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4010) pooled source contexts. It includes Context construction/close, full directory production, both first-prefix read/validate and read/child-program phases, and disposal of every owned output. The candidate also shares Context.high_count's radix traversal, doubling the [PR #4025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4025) producer-only saving.

At actual pooled native IDLE896352 (rank 14, Q6512), with old common COPY1603 and IDLE contexts, four original/candidate combinations produce identical bytes and restore all protected bytes, heads and ownership. At dimension64/cap 1, source actions fall **11,709,798→2,023,876 (82.716%)** for h0/B1 and **21,090,379→10,356,737 (50.894%)** for h2/B2. Record, residue and index lanes remain separate; these totals are source operations, not wall-clock or a physical-machine tariff. Two radix families save exactly **8190*(523 reads,95 writes,556 moves)**. Admission savings add independently with no cross term. No extra tape, numerical Word, peak or backing slot is introduced.

The current source's actual compiled fallback plan begins with a UNIT child, admitted current width 2048→32. Low specifications are independently compiled from the complete source export, not copied projections. Histories are legal generic admitted histories; literal selected top-level reachability is not claimed. Finite complete dimension64 cubes have cap 1/modulus 3. Geometry, child_extents, handoff copies, arbitrary dirty acquisition, transport, coefficients, control/allocator tariffs, original-width stock and remaining Pi terms are open. No full physical CALL/RETURN, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

Only `research/r437-preparation-composition/` is added. Its self-contained pooled export authenticates154 files; exact [PR #4025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4025) source/notice and [PR #4011](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4011) adapter bytes are retained. Four-way replay checks the complete phase partition, output identity, all borrowed/created state and erased backing. The separate no-runtime-import invoice derives the exact record/radix delta. Eleven controls include actual same-output losing compositions that omit Context sharing or silently skip validation, plus AST/source-context/invoice controls. Registered normal and optimized results and publication/CI receipts are reported after final preflight.

Canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority 6. Explicit multi-agent donor assignment changes selected-stock-envelope to this bounded preparation join. Parent checked 733 open PR bodies at 10:46UTC and fresh R437 search; broader Discussion/closed/code coverage partial. [PR #4025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4025)'s released handoff is built upon. No shared/frozen source or selected-frontier file is changed.

Credit: ToikY/[PR #4025](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4025) supplies shared radix and exact traversal invoice; ywz65/[PR #2590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2590) supplied the cubic setup analysis and explicit optimization question, and [PR #2566](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2566) primitive analysis. Ross Richardson retains numerical peak credit. Chris R/Clear1nsight [PR #4011](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4011) supplies forward admission; [PR #4010](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4010) supplies pooled compilation. Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, David Arias/[PR #2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753), Nick Petalas and the complete retained R437/OQ4/pooling lineage retain runtime and construction credit; full notices are preserved. New composition/proof/controls by Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI review. Apache-2.0; no independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Open next questions: join geometry, extents and fixed handoff with these same contexts; lower source operations to a fixed physical tariff and price simultaneous lifetimes at original widths. Unknown costs remain unknown. No merge or closure requested.

Publication packaging: the 154 frozen [PR #4010](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4010) source files are retained byte-for-byte under vendor/ and authenticated against the unchanged source manifest. Existing Git blobs are reused during publication; no large archive upload is required. The original archive and its digest remain local evidence. This changes only transport, preserving the scientific receipt and executable source bytes.

Packaging validation: all three registered commands pass normally. A 178-file Git-free package-only export passes all three optimized commands with unchanged hashes. All eleven controls additionally pass from a read-only source export (files 0444, directories 0555), also unchanged. A separate AI packaging review found no blocker and compared all 154 sources with the original archive. Official committed-ref export and hosted CI are reported separately.
